mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS MoM < -0.5% does not correlate with subsequent GDP growth deceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE MoM > 0.3% does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and low CPIAUCSL YoY does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in GDP (GDPC1) indicates a potential economic imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of increasing HOUST and decreasing GDPC1 does not correlate with subsequent economic downturns.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) are increasing, it signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combination of low UNRATE and increasing PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a potential pause in tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases after a series of increases
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or a decrease in FEDFUNDS during a tightening cycle does not correlate with subsequent positive market reactions.
